1. WordPress:- WordPress is ideal for content driven websites and businesses that need flexibility. It offers strong SEO capabilities, customisation, and control over your website structure
2. Shopify:- Shopify works best for ecommerce businesses looking for an easy to manage platform. It simplifies product management, payments, and store setup without needing technical expertise
3. Custom websites:- Custom websites are built from scratch and offer complete control. They are perfect for businesses with specific functionality needs, scalability goals, or unique user experience requirements
